definitions.explanation: A continuous stretch of land or space.
The entirety of a particular area.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{一帯|いったい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{工業|こうぎょう}→工業：01402_kougyou⟧⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This area is an industrial zone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧{一帯|いったい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}された→開発する：06746_kaihatsu⟧。
examples.english: The entire area around the station was developed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一帯|いったい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{積|つ}もった→積もる：01964_tsumoru⟧。
examples.english: Snow accumulated across the mountain region.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧{一帯|いったい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The whole coastal area has become a park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧{一帯|いったい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The entire town area suffered major damage from the earthquake.

notes:
{一帯|いったい} refers to a broad, continuous stretch of land or geographical area. It often follows a place name or location word to mean "the whole area around ~."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{一帯|いったい}: this (whole) area
- ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧{一帯|いったい}: the entire coastal area
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧{一帯|いったい}: the whole area around the station
- {一帯|いったい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: to spread across the area

WATCH OUT:
Different from ⟦{一体|いったい}→一体：01731_ittai⟧ (what on earth; one body) — same reading but different kanji and completely different meaning. {一帯|いったい} is always geographical.
